cause: The execute runner returned file-backed Tested state using sha256=<digest> instead of the canonical sha256:<64 lowercase hex> token; the strict caller classified the response as malformed.
rootCauseAssessment: The runner violated the already strict digest grammar at the delimiter level. The caller did not recompute, repair, or accept the malformed token; an explicit delimiter guard is required to make the producer contract operationally unambiguous.
